title: Structure generation
action: Construct the AlB2-type and ThSi2-type crystal structures of CaSi2 using the provided lattice parameters and atomic positions. Then generate pure Si network structures by removing Ca atoms from these models.
description: Generate all four structural models required for calculations.

title: DFT self-consistent and band calculation
action: Using an open-source DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO), perform LDA calculations for each of the four systems. First, run self-consistent field (SCF) calculations with a suitable k-point mesh that includes Gamma to obtain converged charge density and effective potential. Then, from the converged potential, compute eigenvalues and wavefunctions at the Gamma point (k=0,0,0) for each system.
description: DFT calculation producing wavefunctions at Gamma needed for orbital projection.

title: Orbital projection for CaSi2 AlB2
action: Using the Gamma-point wavefunctions from step_2 for CaSi2 AlB2, project wavefunctions onto atomic pseudo-atomic orbitals (s, px, py, pz for Si, and s, px, py, pz, d orbitals for Ca). For bands 1-10, output a JSON file containing band index, energy (eV), and the normalized projection coefficients.
description: Orbital projection data for CaSi2 in AlB2 structure at Gamma point.
output_schema: JSON array of 10 objects, each with band_index (int), energy_eV (float), s (float), px (float), py (float), pz (float), d_Ca (object with keys like s, px, py, pz, d_xy, d_yz, d_z2, d_xz, d_yz and float values).

title: Orbital projection for CaSi2 ThSi2
action: Using the Gamma-point wavefunctions from step_2 for CaSi2 ThSi2, project wavefunctions onto atomic pseudo-atomic orbitals and output the JSON file.
description: Orbital projection data for CaSi2 in ThSi2 structure at Gamma point.
output_schema: JSON array of 10 objects, each with band_index (int), energy_eV (float), s (float), px (float), py (float), pz (float), d_Ca (object with keys like s, px, py, pz, d_xy, d_yz, d_z2, d_xz, d_yz and float values).

title: Orbital projection for Si AlB2 network
action: Using the Gamma-point wavefunctions from step_2 for the pure Si AlB2-type network, project wavefunctions onto Si atomic orbitals and output the JSON file.
description: Orbital projection data for pure Si network derived from AlB2 CaSi2 at Gamma point.
output_schema: JSON array of 10 objects, each with band_index (int), energy_eV (float), s (float), px (float), py (float), pz (float).

title: Orbital projection for Si ThSi2 network
action: Using the Gamma-point wavefunctions from step_2 for the pure Si ThSi2-type network, project wavefunctions onto Si atomic orbitals and output the JSON file.
description: Orbital projection data for pure Si network derived from ThSi2 CaSi2 at Gamma point.
output_schema: JSON array of 10 objects, each with band_index (int), energy_eV (float), s (float), px (float), py (float), pz (float).
